tools.name: get_tb_spread
tools.description:
Top-Bottom (TBx) spread — daily battery-arbitrage benchmark.
TBx = sum(top X priced hours) − sum(bottom X priced hours) over the
day-ahead clearing prices for `zone` on `date`. The day is the SDAC
market day (23/25 hours on DST-transition days). `date` must be a
bare YYYY-MM-DD — time-bearing string

tools.name: data_coverage
tools.description:
Show what data is available and how current it is for (endpoint × zone)
— call before querying if you're not sure a recent date is available yet.
Each pair's newest year carries `latest_data_at`, its newest stored
